synchronousWatchRegistration.runtime: Private WatchHandle.spawn polls only immediate task registration once through UniFFI's existing async-compat Tokio runtime; no new runtime, dependency or public API
synchronousWatchRegistration.lifetime: Stop and last-handle drop request abort, without joining or synchronously interrupting non-cooperative foreign code. Connection close cancels pending path callbacks; endpoint close cancels address/home-relay stream waits and callbacks. Terminal PathClosed delivery is not guaranteed on whole-connection shutdown.
sourceAnchors: uniffi 0.31.2 tokio export adapter and uniffi_core async_compat re-export
synchronousWatchRegistration.verification: Plain Rust tests use bounded callback and task-closure observations; not executed by worker. Path-event registration/natural closure is covered, not forced live path migration or guaranteed terminal-event delivery.

networkChangeWatcher.ownership: One endpoint-owned lazy monitor and hint source, shared by clones and protocol-creator handles; monitor and hint channel are created only when watched
networkChangeWatcher.explicitHints: Forward to core and the shared netwatch monitor; coalesce explicit Android hints through Tokio watch because Android RouteMonitor is a no-op and netwatch suppresses equal interface states
networkChangeWatcher.lifetime: WatchHandle.stop and last-handle drop request abort; endpoint.closed cancels monitor initialization and in-flight callbacks; Endpoint.close releases the shared monitor

advisoryDatabase.coverage: Neither required GHSA is indexed in this snapshot; supplementary upstream version exclusions are required
